title: Account Dashboard: Activate Site
text:
## Account Dashboard: Activate Site
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000081625
When logged into the Account Dashboard, all licenses that have been purchased but are not yet activated, will display on the Ready to Activate tab.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12175413416/original/Atos1H1LLVJ17_fWHmGp6k7f_tyTtYHBHg.png?1772508138 | alt: ]
Inactive / Archived Sites Section – Displays websites that are not currently active and require activation or restoration.
Inactive / Archived Sites Section – Displays websites that are not currently active and require activation or restoration.
Site ID Badge – Displays the unique Site ID assigned to the website.
Site ID Badge – Displays the unique Site ID assigned to the website.

Status Label – Displays the current site status (e.g., Archived) along with the archive date when applicable.

Website URL – Displays the primary domain associated with the website (if available).

Plan Label – Displays the associated subscription plan (e.g., Lifetime Plan).
Add-Ons Indicators – Displays active add-ons associated with the website (e.g., VIP Add-Ons Club, Instant Business Records).

## Activate Site Section
Activate Site Button – Initiates the site activation process for websites eligible for activation (e.g., Lifetime Plan sites).
Activate Site Button – Initiates the site activation process for websites eligible for activation (e.g., Lifetime Plan sites).
Activation Process – Re-enables the website and makes it accessible under the associated plan configuration.
Activation Process – Re-enables the website and makes it accessible under the associated plan configuration.

## Restore Site Section
Restore Button (Dropdown) – Initiates the restoration process for archived websites.
Restore Button (Dropdown) – Initiates the restoration process for archived websites.
Restore Process – Reinstates the archived website to active status, preserving previous configuration and associated data where applicable.
Restore Process – Reinstates the archived website to active status, preserving previous configuration and associated data where applicable.
There are two reasons an account will have Websites to Activate . The first reason is it's a brand new, recently purchase license that has not yet been activated.
The second reason is a previously-active website has been converted into a credit because it has not been actively used for a long time, or the license owner requested it be converted to a credit.

## Activate Site
Credits related to a license that has never been used for an active website will not have a backup of a previous website associated with it.  In these cases, the purple button will have a single option: "Activate Site":
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12175412896/original/f_MF5SQw92ziSnMjyf9ukFbm-SD1artgBQ.png?1772507147 | alt: ]
*Clicking on this button will launch a new website.

## Credits Related to a Previously Active Website
When a previously active website is converted to a credit, a full backup of the site is made first, and will be available for up to one year from the date it was converted to a credit.
If a credit is related to one of these websites, the green button will be a dropdown with the following options:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12175413381/original/WUVeyMAXsjej2gKyxeVdLzrj3PpGbke3IQ.png?1772508110 | alt: ]

## Restore Website from Backup
Choosing this option will re-launch the website exactly as it was before it was converted to a credit.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12175413424/original/LpGaVyll8ZjsHSDl6uqmMI6PmvI7N9ZQ5g.png?1772508219 | alt: ]

## Launch New Site
Choosing this option will delete the backup of the previous website and launch a brand new website. Select this option if the previous site is no longer needed and a brand new website should be launched instead.
This will use any back up saved on file.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12175413517/original/iUFJHZFtM12_q_5JkX5BPQieuSU69H4WAQ.png?1772508279 | alt: ]
Select from any of the available themes (optional).
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12175413690/original/7o-RYP1cy5NfXPhEZ6Pi9W2oXPj5-aHZvQ.png?1772509016 | alt: ]

## Contact Support
Choosing this option will allow the site owner to submit a support ticket for additional assistance.
